decisions.statement: A chapter list is read off the `window.chapters` array the page has.
A fiction's title and author are read off the linked-data Book block the page has.
A chapter is not always laid out in paragraph tags.
A chapter with no paragraph tag is read by its line breaks instead.
A chapter that yields a paragraph is read byte for byte as that chapter was before.
A container that is absent and a container that yields nothing are two readings.

definition: a Royal Road fiction page and chapter page read into values
